description: This file implements functions to measure stack consumption during signal handling on various architectures, using signal handlers and alternate stacks to determine stack usage of specific code segments.

methods.name: GetStackConsumption
methods.description: Calculates the stack usage based on the touched portion of an alternate stack buffer.

methods.name: GetSignalHandlerStackConsumption
methods.description: Sets up signal handlers and alternate stack to measure the stack consumption of a specified signal handler function.
